body.Title: PFMOffices
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) list of coordinating offices: one row per office, with its endorser and coordination role. Endorsement routing reuses it. Office data stays in SharePoint.

body.Title: PFMProcessSteps
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) list of process steps for one publication action, derived from Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, with Table A5.2 target business days. Status: draft, not verified (docs/process-model.md).

body.Title: PFMSeries
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) list of publication series numbers and titles from Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, Attachment 2, Table A2.1. Add or rename a series here; no schema change is needed.

body.Title: PFMSettings
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) settings: one row per setting the app and flows read (wing name for the subtitle, PFM mailbox, defaults). Values are entered on the government computer, never in the code repository.

body.Title: PFMProductIndex
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) product index (PI) of all applicable organizational publications and forms that the PFM maintains (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 6.4.2).

body.Title: PFMPublications
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of actions: one row per action on a publication or form (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 1.1.4), with its process step, certification and approval. Each action points to its PFM Product Index row.

body.Title: PFMActivityLog
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of events: status change, endorsement requested, reminder sent, status report e-mailed. One row per event. Flow run history expires after 28 days; this list keeps the record.

body.Title: PFMEndorsements
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of coordination: one row per coordinator per action, with stage, role, status, suspense, response and nonconcur resolution (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 3.4 and 5.1-5.5).

body.Title: PFMReviews
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of reviews: one row per periodic or special review of a product (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 7.4.2-7.4.4), with the office of primary responsibility (OPR) response, due dates and the follow-up action.

body.Title: Nuclear, Space, Missile, or Command and Control Operations
CoordinationSuspenseBusinessDays
body.SettingNotes: Business days a coordinator gets to respond (DAFMAN 90-161 5.2). Flows count weekdays only; holidays not excluded.

body.Title: GuardReserveApplicabilityCalendarDays
body.SettingNotes: Calendar days for Guard Applicability and Reserve Applicability coordinators below major command (MAJCOM) level (DAFMAN 90-161 5.2.2).

body.Title: Preparation: directive or not, existing pubs, prior record set, contact PCM/PFM
Privacy monitor review: the unit privacy monitor reviews the draft before formal coordination
Formal coordination: package = Word draft (flush left) + CRM + DAF Form 673
body.ExitCondition: All coordinators responded; all nonconcurs resolved (5.5.1)

body.Title: Legal coordination (servicing legal office below HQ DAF), after all other coordination and adjudication
Certification: certifying official endorses DAF Form 673
Approval: approving official endorses DAF Form 673; delegation letter on file
Submission: OPR sends 673 (or DAF Form 399 for certify-current), draft, figure files to PFM
Posting: ANG wing PFM distributes on approved websites or other approved methods; updates the PI
